snippet.title: Sponge Break Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Reveal trailer for Sponge Break? - A co-op adventure game where you try to get one extremely fragile raft down a very dangerous river! 
🧽 Join the Sponge Break Playtest ► https://SpongeBreak.com 
⭐ Wishlist Sponge Break on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2657560/Sponge_Break/
🗣️ Join the community on Discord ► https://Discord.gg/SpongeBreak
 
―――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

You're a sponge. You're on a raft. The river is trying to destroy you.
Sponge Break is a 1–4 player chaotic co-op game where you and your crew try to get one extremely fragile raft down a very dangerous river. Use proximity voice chat to coordinate (or panic), steer together down the rapids, solve puzzles, and fight beavers. Yes, beavers.

The invite-only Playtest is live now through July 28. Sign up for your chance to get in: https://SpongeBreak.com

―――――――――――――――――――――――――――――
